title: Two Chinese Art Competitions
content: Two different international art competitions hosted by organizers from China are looking for submissions.In “Share One Planet,” they’re looking for digital paintings of wild animals. I’ll be one of the judges. Arnie and Cathy Fenner of Spectrum will also be judging.For oil painters, there’s another art competition called “American China Oil Painting League,” ACOPAL. Winning paintings will be exhibited in New York and Beijing. The deadline for that one is April 18.----Share One PlanetACOPAL
